button.tutorialtracker.container.tooltip: Counts this container's contents for the material list. They are updated every time you open it.
message.tutorialtracker.container_added_: %s assigned – open it once so its contents are counted
message.tutorialtracker.not_a_container: Look at a chest, barrel, shulker box or ender chest
message.tutorialtracker.no_video: This project has no video link yet (press B)
screen.tutorialtracker.title: Tutorial Tracker
screen.tutorialtracker.url.hint: Paste a YouTube, Twitch or web link (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V)
screen.tutorialtracker.empty: No materials yet. Paste the link to a tutorial above and click "Load" – the material list is read from the video description. If it is somewhere else, use "Paste material list".
screen.tutorialtracker.status.blocked: YouTube blocked the request (bot check). Try again later or add the list with "Paste material list".
screen.tutorialtracker.status.none: No material list found – add it with "Paste material list"
screen.tutorialtracker.containers.hint: Look at a chest or shulker box and press K, or use the button next to an open chest.
screen.tutorialtracker.containers.unseen: %s container(s) not opened yet – open them once so their contents are counted.
Remove all containers from this project? The containers themselves stay as they are.
screen.tutorialtracker.paste.tooltip: For lists in a comment, on a website or anywhere else
screen.tutorialtracker.unmatched.tooltip: These lines had an amount but no known item. Add them with "Add item" if needed:
screen.tutorialtracker.paste.title: Paste material list
screen.tutorialtracker.paste.placeholder:
e.g.
64x Hopper
3 stacks of cobblestone
Sticky Piston x12
2 shulkers of glass
screen.tutorialtracker.paste.help: English and German item names are recognised. Stacks and shulkers are converted.
screen.tutorialtracker.add_item.title: Add item
screen.tutorialtracker.tools.message: To play videos in game the mod needs three free programs: yt-dlp (finds the video stream), ffmpeg (decodes picture and sound) and Deno (needed by yt-dlp for YouTube). Ones already installed are used directly. Missing ones can be downloaded once into the "tutorialtracker/bin" folder of your Minecraft folder. The material list and container counting work without them.
screen.tutorialtracker.tools.finished: Done! You can play videos now.
video.tutorialtracker.error: The video could not be played
popup.tutorialtracker.no_materials: No materials yet – load a tutorial link in the menu (B).
screen.tutorialtracker.arrange.tooltip: Move and resize the material list and video windows at full size over the game (key U). The arrow keys move the clicked window exactly; with Alt (Mac: Option) they resize it.
screen.tutorialtracker.arrange.hint: Drag: move · Corner: resize · Arrows (+Alt): fine-tune · Esc/U: back
settings.tutorialtracker.windows: Windows: drag · bottom right corner = size
screen.tutorialtracker.tools.locked: Another program is holding the file, usually the virus scanner checking the new download. Wait a few seconds and click the button again.
settings.tutorialtracker.update.ready: Version %s installs on the next start
message.tutorialtracker.update_ready: Tutorial Tracker %s is downloaded and installs on the next start.
screen.tutorialtracker.archive.tooltip: All projects with picture, version and list: open again, rename, delete or share as a code with friends
screen.tutorialtracker.archive.import.to: Reads a shared code from the clipboard (copied from Discord, say) and adds the project to the archive. Copying the whole message is fine.
screen.tutorialtracker.archive.export.to: Copies list, link and version as a short code, to paste into Discord or anywhere else. Chests belong to your world and are not shared.
screen.tutorialtracker.archive.name: Name:
screen.tutorialtracker.archive.empty: No projects yet. Paste a tutorial link in the menu (B), or copy a shared code and click "Paste code".
screen.tutorialtracker.archive.copied: Code copied (%s characters), now paste it into Discord or elsewhere
screen.tutorialtracker.archive.no_code: No Tutorial Tracker code in the clipboard
